proposals.evidence: DEDR 757(a) explicitly gives Kurukh oṛᵒk/oṛok ‘bark of tree’. Survey ōḍak is a comparative match with vowel length and the ḍ versus ṛ transcription difference retained; the correct subsection is the bark/peel group, not the uk- subgroup (b). This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
